upstream.description: AAS Core is the local, agent-first control plane for complete catalog discovery, agent-owned selection, stack validation, and planning, backed by 2,005+ agentic skills. Includes CLI, local MCP, catalog, plugins, and Workbench.

classification.analysis: AAS Core (agentic-awesome-skills) is a large local, agent-first catalog and control plane of 2,000+ reusable SKILL.md playbooks for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Kiro, Copilot, and more), packaged as a local MCP server, CLI, and a browser-local Workbench for reviewing agent-selected skill stacks. Instead of ranking or auto-installing skills, it lets the agent inspect a project, search the full catalog, and compose a validated, reproducible manifest (aas-stack.json) before anything is applied. It targets developers who want a curated, distributable skill/plugin ecosystem across multiple AI coding agents rather than ad-hoc prompt copying.

use_cases.title: Install a curated skill pack for Claude Code or Cursor from a large catalog
Let an agent search and compose its own validated skill stack via local MCP
Review and approve an agent's proposed skill selection before applying it
Bootstrap a new coding agent project with a specialized plugin bundle
